Worldometer is the shared country/territory list for profiles and population rankings: https://www.worldometers.info/world-population/population-by-country/ . Snapshot retrieved 2026-10-31; 234 countries and dependencies, 2026 population estimates. Source snapshot: data/worldometer-countries.json in the public source repository. Rebuild with node scripts/build-country-data.cjs. Stable ISO codes and regions derive from world-countries 5.1.0 under the existing ODbL; original-name aliases remain searchable.

Country/territory catalogue: world-countries 5.1.0, https://github.com/mledoze/countries . Derived fields: code, iso2, common name, region. Antarctica excluded. This catalogue is provided under the Open Database License (ODbL); see country-catalog-LICENSE.txt. Download the derived list at country-catalog.json. Map geometry: the existing world-countries.json atlas map; small countries and territories may have no polygon. This catalogue licence concerns the public geographic dataset, not access permissions for personal account records.
City search: Open-Meteo Geocoding API (https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/geocoding-api), based on GeoNames (https://www.geonames.org/), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). City search results are displayed as city, country and administrative region.

Detailed profile and scratch animation outlines: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-0 map units, public domain. https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/10m-cultural-vectors/ and https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/ . Retrieved 2026-10-31 from the Natural Earth source repository (nvkelso/natural-earth-vector); topology-preserving display simplification 0.003 degrees. Natural Earth uses cartographic, de facto boundaries by default. All 234 catalogue entries have mapped geometry. Fixed colour adjacency is based on these outlines.

Country flags: flag-icons 7.6.0 by lipis and contributors, MIT licence. https://github.com/lipis/flag-icons . SVG assets hosted locally in flags/; full licence at flags/LICENSE.txt.
